title: Ashish Kumar v. Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Naheed Ara Moonis, J.; Dinesh Pathak, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed for alternative remedy of Section 127 appeal.
headnote: A writ to quash a Collector's recovery citation issued after confirmation of a final assessment, and to compel decision on objections and restoration of supply, is not maintainable where the consumer does not dispute that an appeal lies under Section 127; the petition is dismissed for alternative remedy.
facts: After inspection of his premises, Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. made a provisional assessment against Ashish Kumar on 1 October 2019. He filed no reply. The assessment was confirmed as final on 16 December 2019. The Collector, Mau, then issued a recovery citation dated 29 June 2020. The petitioner approached the High Court to quash that citation, compel a decision on his objection to the final assessment, and restore electricity supply, alleging that a representation against the assessment notice remained pending.

holding_units.holding: Where a provisional assessment has been confirmed as final and the consumer does not dispute that an appeal lies against that assessment, a writ seeking to quash a Collector's recovery citation, to compel decision on objections, and to restore supply is dismissed for alternative remedy under Section 127.
holding_units.flag: Court referred to 'Section 127 of the Electricity Supply Code'; s.127 is of the Electricity Act, 2003.

principle_tags.application: Writ against recovery citation, pending objection, and disconnection after a confirmed final assessment dismissed because a Section 127 appeal was available and not disputed.
Confirmation of the 16.12.2019 final assessment, with no reply to the 1.10.2019 provisional assessment, was treated as attracting the Section 127 appeal and not a writ.

not_decided.point: merits of the 16.12.2019 final assessment, the 29.06.2020 recovery citation, restoration of supply, and the pending representation
not_decided.note: left open by dismissal for Section 127 appeal
